test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Repairing.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5 is Repairing.
 
• Repairing means repairing something that is broken, damaged, or not functioning properly in order to make it functional once more.
 
• Thus the correct word is **Repairing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Removing** means to **relocate or alter one's place of residence, employment, or station.**
 
• **Healing** means **the process of restoring one's health or soundness.**
 
• **Praying** means** making a request in prayer.**
